- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Babur faced a rebellion from his half-brother, Jahangir Mirza, who seized Kabul.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Babur had to fight Jahangir Mirza to regain control of Kabul.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Babur exiled Humayun and transferred allegiance to his younger son, Kamran.
